translations.literal: The Histories section has sixteen categories: first, Standard Histories; second, Annals; third, Comprehensive Accounts of Events; fourth, Alternative Histories; fifth, Miscellaneous Histories; sixth, Edicts, Orders, Memorials, and Deliberations; seventh, Biographies; eighth, Historical Excerpts; ninth, Regional Chronicles; tenth, Seasonal Regulations; eleventh, Geography; twelfth, Official Posts; thirteenth, Administrative Treatises; fourteenth, Bibliographies; fifteenth, Metal and Stone Inscriptions; sixteenth, Historical Criticism.
translations.idiomatic: The Histories division comprises sixteen categories: (1) standard histories, (2) annals, (3) comprehensive accounts of events, (4) alternative histories, (5) miscellaneous histories, (6) edicts and memorials, (7) biographies, (8) historical excerpts, (9) regional chronicles, (10) seasonal regulations, (11) geography, (12) official posts, (13) administrative treatises, (14) bibliographies, (15) epigraphy, and (16) historical criticism.
